title: ESG / GHG Scope 1, 2 and 3 — Full 25 Markdown Documentation
validated_against: GHG Protocol Corporate Standard, Scope 2 Guidance, Corporate Value Chain (Scope 3) Standard, Scope 3 Calculation Guidance, GHG Protocol IPCC GWP Values (August 2024), IPCC AR6 GWP tables, current GHG Protocol revision-status publications checked 2026-08-11, PCAF official Part A 3rd edition (2025), and CEA Indian power-sector baseline database availability.
important_note: Current GHG Protocol standards are distinguished from draft 2025-2026 revisions. Draft proposals must not be treated as production requirements.
corrections: Category 2 cradle-to-gate boundary and transport separation
Category 11 direct/indirect use-phase and lifetime assumptions
Category 15 investment-type and PCAF-aligned methodology controls
audit_notes: Current GHG Protocol corporate standards remain the operative baseline; 2025-2026 revision materials are not production requirements.
GHG Protocol announced on 2026-07-29 a new GHGP/ISO harmonized corporate-standard development timeline, with consolidated public consultation planned for Q2 2027 and publication planned for Q4 2028.
The supplied 2025 conversion-factor workbook is not a universal 2026 factor set; factor selection must be geography- and applicability-year-aware.
PCAF Part A 3rd edition (2025) should be used/versioned where Category 15 financed-emissions methods apply.
The documentation is methodology-focused; numeric factor validation cannot be completed from this ZIP alone because the referenced source workbooks/PDFs are not included in the uploaded archive.
